Five bedroom farm house with accommodation for up to 13 persons in beds. Beautiful surroundings and view from the property. Very private with a large garden, terrace and outdoor area, perfect for families with children or groups. Large fully equipped kitchen with dining area, living rooms with a mountain view and an extra sofa bed.
Property is located near many of Iceland´s most spectacular places to visits. Seljalandsfoss, Vestman Islands, Thorsmork, Skogafoss and Vik, all within 1 hour drive.

The space
Perfect location for watching northern lights.
Guests are welcome to visit our family farm in the neighbourhood! cows, calves, sheep, lambs, cats and chickens!
